title: dendrobium × vonpaulsenianum
intro: Dendrobium × vonpaulsenianum, commonly known as the hybrid orchid, is a man-made hybrid plant resulting from the cross-breeding of Dendrobium nobile and Dendrobium cruentum. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium × vonpaulsenianum include its potential in treating various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in various studies.
